patch.value: Documented install command fails: pm install github.com/unbraind/pm-csv cannot resolve an entry file

value.author: claude
value.text: REPRODUCED on pm 2026.7.25: `pm install github.com/unbraind/pm-csv --project` fails with `Extension entry file is missing at ".../dist/index.js"`. Root cause: `dist/` is in .gitignore and no build output is committed, and pm never runs a build when installing from a GitHub source - it copies the repository as-is.

value.author: claude
value.text: FIX: document `pm install npm:pm-csv`, verified working end to end. npm is the actual distribution channel for this package - the Daily Release workflow publishes it and `prepack` builds dist into the tarball - so the npm source needs no build output in git. Rejected committing dist/: build artifacts under version control invite drift (pm-web already tracks 72 dist files against 30 produced by a clean build) and add a conflict surface to the multi-agent merge workflow.

value.author: claude
value.text: Bare-name installs do NOT reach npm: `pm install pm-csv --project` fails with `Local extension source does not exist`, because a bare target resolves only a local directory or a bundled alias. The `npm:` prefix is required.

patch.value: Documented pm install npm:pm-csv, verified working; GitHub source cannot work without committed build output
